events.title: 4 important takeaways from Nvidia's earnings
events.body: In addition to the earnings release, Nvidia's CFO Colette Kress shared commentary that revealed four key developments in its business, beyond the company's first quarter earnings-per-share beat.

events.title: Nvidia Raises Dividend 2,400%. It No Longer Has the Lowest Yield in the S&P 500.
events.body: One theme of Nvidia's fiscal first-quarter results is capital return to shareholders. The company increased its quarterly payout to 25 cents from 1 cent. That's a 2,400% increase. Nvidia increased its dividend by 900% in mid-2024.
